analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,优化 RSV 免疫教育对于改善接种和预防策略至关重要,特别是在新引入 尼塞韦单抗 的环境中。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 低答复率(19.3%)和地域不平衡(90%的答复来自西班牙和意大利)限制了普遍性,而且该研究依赖于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入偏差。

title: The economic impact of pediatric RSV-related lower respiratory tract infection in Germany: evidence from the PAPI study
abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute lower respiratory tract infections (LRTI) in infants and young children. While considerable research has described the clinical burden and direct medical costs of RSV in Germany, the broader economic impact remains poorly understood, particularly the burden on affected families and productivity losses associated with parental work absence. METHODS: The prospective, multicenter PAPI study was conducted across 12 hospitals and five pediatric practices in Germany during the 2021-2022 and 2022-2023 RSV seasons. Children under 24 months presenting with lower respiratory tract infections were tested for RSV. Health care resource use, parental expenses, and absenteeism were assessed through questionnaires and follow-up interviews. The human capital approach was used to estimate productivity losses. RESULTS: Of 1,607 hospitalized children, 918 (57.1%) tested positive for RSV and 714 were included in the analysis. In the outpatient setting, 286 of 1,442 cases (19.8%) were RSV-positive, with 250 included in the analysis. Among hospitalized RSV cases, 91.3% required additional primary care visits. Parental work loss was reported in 64.3% of hospitalized and 37.5% of outpatient cases. Mean productivity losses were €1,865 for hospitalized cases and €1,484 for outpatient cases associated with parental work loss. Productivity losses were higher for toddlers (aged 12-23 months) than infants (0-11 months), with hospitalized toddlers showing the highest mean loss of €2,584 per case involving parental work absence. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that RSV infections in children under two years impose a substantial economic burden on the German health care system and parents. The findings provide critical evidence to support decision-making on preventive strategies aimed at reducing RSV-related morbidity and its economic consequences in Germany.

title: Uptake of the RSVpreF vaccine during pregnancy: associations with socioeconomic status, prenatal care utilization, and maternal risk factors.
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of infant respiratory illness. In August 2023, the RSV protein-based vaccine (RSVpreF) became the first maternal vaccine approved in the United States to prevent RSV infection in newborns. The study aims to estimate RSVpreF vaccine uptake during its first RSV season and to identify key factors associated with uptake among commercially insured pregnant individuals, using Optum's Clinformatics® Data Mart Database. The study included individuals aged 18-50 with live birth deliveries at or after 32 weeks' gestation between October 1, 2023, and January 31, 2024, continuous enrollment from July 1, 2022, through delivery, and available socioeconomic records. Among 14,121 pregnant individuals,14.5% received the RSVpreF vaccine. Uptake rose from 1.5% among the October 2023 delivery cohort to 28.7% among the January 2024 cohort; 84.6% were vaccinated within the recommended 32-36 week gestational window. In multivariable models, higher uptake was associated with age (30-39 vs 18-29 years: OR = 1.52, 95% CI: 1.28-1.80), household income $60,000-$74,000 (OR = 1.40, 95% CI: 1.05-1.85) or $75,000-$99,000 (OR = 1.47, 95% CI: 1.13-1.92), bachelor's degree or higher (OR = 1.70, 95% CI: 1.48-1.96), PPO insurance (OR = 2.87, 95% CI: 1.70-4.87), prior influenza vaccination (OR = 1.78, 95% CI: 1.56-2.04), receipt of influenza (OR = 3.65, 95% CI: 3.14-4.24) or Tdap (OR = 4.40, 95% CI: 3.53-5.49) vaccines during pregnancy, and each additional week in the RSVpreF vaccination window(OR = 1.27; 95% CI: 1.06-1.53). Receiving ≥5 of 7 non-vaccine prenatal care services was also associated with higher uptake (OR = 1.82, 95% CI: 1.23-2.70). Comorbidities were not associated with uptake. Maternal RSVpreF vaccine uptake was low during its first on-market season, with significant disparities by sociodemographic factors, uptake of other vaccines, and adherence to recommended prenatal care. Efforts to improve equitable access and education are needed for effective maternal immunization programs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of infant respiratory illness, and in August 2023 the RSV protein-based vaccine (RSVpreF) became the first maternal vaccine approved in the United States to prevent RSV infection in newborns.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study estimated RSVpreF vaccine uptake during its first RSV season and identified factors associated with uptake among commercially insured pregnant individuals using Optum's Clinformatics® Data Mart Database.
analysis.methods: The study included individuals aged 18–50 with live birth deliveries at or after 32 weeks' gestation between October 1, 2023, and January 31, 2024, with continuous enrollment from July 1, 2022, through delivery and available socioeconomic records.
analysis.main_results: Among 14,121 pregnant individuals, 14.5% received the RSVpreF vaccine; uptake rose from 1.5% in the October 2023 delivery cohort to 28.7% in the January 2024 cohort, and 84.6% were vaccinated within the recommended 32–36 week gestational window.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Higher uptake was associated with older age, higher income, higher education, PPO insurance, prior influenza vaccination, receipt of influenza or Tdap vaccines during pregnancy, additional weeks in the vaccination window, and greater adherence to prenatal care.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight disparities in maternal RSVpreF vaccine uptake by sociodemographic factors, other vaccine behaviors, and prenatal care adherence, indicating targets for equitable immunization program improvement.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on a commercially insured population and administrative claims data, which may not capture all relevant clinical or socioeconomic factors, and by the short post-approval observation window.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the uptake of the maternal RSVpreF vaccine during its first U.S. season among 14,121 commercially insured pregnant individuals. Overall uptake was 14.5%, increasing from 1.5% in October 2023 to 28.7% by January 2024, with 84.6% vaccinated within the recommended 32–36 week window. Higher uptake was associated with older maternal age, higher household income and education, PPO insurance, prior influenza vaccination, receipt of influenza or Tdap vaccines during pregnancy, longer gestational time in the vaccination window, and greater adherence to prenatal care. Comorbidities showed no association. The authors conclude that low initial uptake and sociodemographic disparities underscore the need for targeted education and equitable access strategies to optimize maternal immunization programs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是婴儿呼吸道疾病的主要原因,2023 年 8 月,基于 RSV 蛋白的 疫苗 (RSVpreF) 成为美国批准的第一个用于预防新生儿 RSV 感染的孕产妇 疫苗。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究估计了 RSVpreF 疫苗 在第一个 RSV 季节的吸收情况,并使用 Optum 的 Clinformatics® 数据集市数据库确定了与商业保险怀孕个体的吸收相关的因素。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究纳入了2023年10月1日至2024年1月31日之间在妊娠32周或之后进行活产分娩的18-50岁个体,并从2022年7月1日起持续入组,直至分娩和可获得的社会经济记录。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 14,121 名孕妇中,14.5% 接受了 RSVpreF 疫苗;接种率从 2023 年 10 月 队列研究 的 1.5% 上升到 2024 年 1 月 队列研究 的 28.7%,并且 84.6% 在建议的 32-36 周妊娠窗口内接种了疫苗。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 较高的吸收率与年龄较大、收入较高、受教育程度较高、PPO 保险、既往流感 疫苗接种、怀孕期间接受流感或 Tdap 疫苗、疫苗接种 窗口期增加几周以及对产前护理的更大依从性相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了社会人口因素、其他 疫苗 行为和产前护理依从性导致母亲 RSVpreF 疫苗 吸收的差异,表明了公平免疫计划改进的目标。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到商业保险人群和行政索赔数据的依赖(可能无法涵盖所有​​相关的临床或社会经济因素)以及批准后观察窗口较短的限制。

title: The limitations of non-mechanistic methods for characterizing pathogen-pathogen interactions: A simulation study.
abstract: Abstract Pathogen-pathogen interactions occur when infection with one pathogen influences one’s chance of infection or disease due to another. Increasingly, evidence suggests that interactions are a common feature of infectious disease epidemiology. However, due to both the nonlinearities and stochasticity inherent to infectious disease transmission, and the frequency of confounding (e.g., by shared seasonal forcing), simple, purely statistical methods for characterizing interactions may be prone to failure. Here, we perform a simulation study to evaluate several more complex non-mechanistic approaches for inferring causality from time series data: generalized additive models (GAMs), Granger causality, transfer entropy, and convergent cross-mapping (CCM). Specifically, we use a two-pathogen mechanistic transmission model, calibrated to produce dynamics resembling outbreaks of influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), to generate synthetic datasets with a range of values for interaction strength and duration. We then apply each method to all synthetic datasets. analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Pathogen-pathogen interactions influence the risk of infection or disease from one pathogen due to another, and such interactions are increasingly recognized as common in infectious disease epidemiology. The study highlights a knowledge gap regarding the reliability of non-mechanistic statistical methods for inferring causality from time-series data in this context.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study performed a simulation-based evaluation of four non-mechanistic methods—generalized additive models (GAMs), Granger causality, transfer entropy, and convergent cross-mapping (CCM)—using synthetic outbreak datasets generated from a two-pathogen mechanistic transmission model calibrated to resemble influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) dynamics.

The methods were also tested on two real-world datasets from Hong Kong and Canada.
analysis_en.main_results: Granger causality, transfer entropy, and CCM frequently failed to correctly identify interactions, with average sensitivities of 80.6%, 92.1%, and 72.1% and specificities of 31.0%, 33.3%, and 33.1%, respectively. title_zh: 表征病原体-病原体相互作用的非机械方法的局限性:模拟研究。
source_body_en: Abstract Pathogen-pathogen interactions occur when infection with one pathogen influences one’s chance of infection or disease due to another. Increasingly, evidence suggests that interactions are a common feature of infectious disease epidemiology. However, due to both the nonlinearities and stochasticity inherent to infectious disease transmission, and the frequency of confounding (e.g., by shared seasonal forcing), simple, purely statistical methods for characterizing interactions may be prone to failure. Here, we perform a simulation study to evaluate several more complex non-mechanistic approaches for inferring causality from time series data: generalized additive models (GAMs), Granger causality, transfer entropy, and convergent cross-mapping (CCM). Specifically, we use a two-pathogen mechanistic transmission model, calibrated to produce dynamics resembling outbreaks of influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), to generate synthetic datasets with a range of values for interaction strength and duration. We then apply each method to all synthetic datasets. We find that Granger causality, transfer entropy, and CCM all fail to consistently infer whether data contain signal of an interaction; in particular, methods tend to incorrectly identify interactions where none are modeled (average sensitivity = 80.6%, 92.1%, 72.1%, respectively; average specificity = 31.0%, 33.3%, 33.1%). Furthermore, we find little to no association between point estimates from each method and true interaction strength. In contrast, GAMs infer the existence of interactions more accurately than the other methods (sensitivity = 85.2%, specificity = 72.5%), and consistently yield larger point estimates for stronger interactions. However, their practical utility is limited by an inability to evaluate interaction asymmetry (i.e., whether the effect of pathogen A on pathogen B is identical to that of B on A). Overall performance patterns were similar when methods were applied to two real-world datasets from Hong Kong and Canada. We conclude that accurately and comprehensively characterizing pathogen-pathogen interactions based on outbreak data remains a significant challenge. For this reason, it is critical that any proposed methods be rigorously evaluated before being used to draw conclusions about interactions. Author Summary Pathogen-pathogen interactions occur when infection with one pathogen either increases or decreases a person’s risk of infection or illness due to a second, distinct pathogen. Because interactions affect several common human pathogens, including influenza and SARS-CoV-2, a better understanding of interactions could improve epidemic control. However, past work has shown that simple methods commonly used to study interactions can lead to inaccurate conclusions. Here, we tested four methods frequently used in other fields, including ecology and neuroscience, to see whether they may also be useful for identifying interactions. Specifically, we tested each method using simulated outbreak data generated from a mathematical model. We found that most methods struggled to correctly determine whether an interaction effect was present; in particular, methods often falsely identified interactions when none occurred. Although one of the tested methods, generalized additive models, performed comparatively well at identifying interactions, it provided relatively little additional information about the interactions. Because pathogen-pathogen interactions are so challenging to study, it is important that researchers rigorously test methods before applying them to interactions, so as not to publish potentially misleading results. More broadly, a complete understanding of interactions will likely require a variety of approaches, including both laboratory and modeling studies.
abstract_zh: 摘要:当一种病原体的感染影响另一种病原体感染或患病的机会时,就会发生病原体与病原体之间的相互作用。越来越多的证据表明,相互作用是传染病 流行病学 的一个共同特征。然而,由于传染病 传播 固有的非线性和随机性,以及混杂的频率(例如,通过共享季节性强迫),用于表征相互作用的简单、纯统计方法可能容易失败。在这里,我们进行了一项模拟研究,以评估从时间序列数据推断因果关系的几种更复杂的非机械方法:广义加性模型(GAM)、格兰杰因果关系、传递熵和收敛交叉映射(CCM)。具体来说,我们使用双病原体机制 传播 模型,经过校准以产生类似于流感 暴发 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 的动力学,以生成具有一系列相互作用强度和持续时间值的合成数据集。然后,我们将每种方法应用于所有合成数据集。我们发现格兰杰因果关系、转移熵和 CCM 都无法一致地推断数据是否包含交互信号;特别是,方法往往会错误地识别未建模的相互作用(平均灵敏度分别为 80.6%、92.1%、72.1%;平均特异性 = 31.0%、33.3%、33.1%)。此外,我们发现每种方法的点估计与真实的相互作用强度之间几乎没有关联。相比之下,GAM 比其他方法更准确地推断相互作用的存在(灵敏度 = 85.2%,特异性 = 72.5%),并且对于更强的相互作用始终产生更大的点估计。然而,它们的实际用途受到无法评估相互作用不对称性的限制(即病原体 A 对病原体 B 的影响是否与 B 对 A 的影响相同)。当将方法应用于来自香港和加拿大的两个现实世界数据集时,总体性能模式相似。我们的结论是,基于 暴发 数据准确、全面地描述病原体与病原体之间的相互作用仍然是一个重大挑战。因此,在用于得出有关相互作用的结论之前,必须对任何提出的方法进行严格评估,这一点至关重要。作者总结 当一种病原体的感染增加或降低一个人因另一种不同的病原体而感染或患病的风险时,就会发生病原体与病原体之间的相互作用。由于相互作用会影响几种常见的人类病原体,包括流感和 SARS-CoV-2,因此更好地了解相互作用可以改善流行病控制。然而,过去的工作表明,通常用于研究相互作用的简单方法可能会导致不准确的结论。在这里,我们测试了生态学和神经科学等其他领域常用的四种方法,看看它们是否也可用于识别相互作用。具体来说,我们使用数学模型生成的模拟 暴发 数据测试了每种方法。我们发现大多数方法都难以正确确定是否存在交互效应;特别是,当没有发生相互作用时,方法经常错误地识别相互作用。尽管其中一种测试方法(广义加性模型)在识别相互作用方面表现相对较好,但它提供的有关相互作用的附加信息相对较少。由于病原体与病原体之间的相互作用的研究非常具有挑战性,因此研究人员在将方法应用于相互作用之前必须严格测试方法,以免发表潜在的误导性结果。更广泛地说,对相互作用的完整理解可能需要多种方法,包括实验室和建模研究。

title: Evaluating the Uptake, Safety and Effectiveness of the Maternal RSV Vaccine (RSVpreF) Against Infant Bronchiolitis: Preliminary Real-World Evidence
abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of infant hospitalization globally. On September 1, 2024, England introduced the bivalent RSVpreF vaccine for maternal immunization following trial evidence of safety and efficacy. However, real-world data on uptake, safety and effectiveness remain limited. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective audit using routinely collected electronic health record data from Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. All live births between September 1 and October 31, 2024, were included. Maternal RSV vaccination status, demographic factors and perinatal outcomes were analyzed. RSV-related hospitalizations were tracked from November 1, 2024, to March 12, 2025. Vaccine effectiveness (VE) was calculated as 1 - (risk in vaccinated/risk in unvaccinated) × 100. RESULTS: Among 1057 live births, 341 mothers (32.3%) received RSVpreF vaccination during pregnancy. Uptake was higher in older and primiparous mothers and strongly associated with receipt of pertussis vaccine (41.3% vs. 11.6%; P 14 days post-vaccination and in 36 of 772 unvaccinated infants, yielding a crude VE of 78.3% (95% confidence interval, 9.1-94.8) in infants <6 months of age. VE against bronchiolitis-coded admissions was 56.4% (95% confidence interval, 13.1-78.2). CONCLUSIONS: Maternal RSV vaccination was associated with substantial protection against infant RSV hospitalization during the first UK season of implementation. Uptake improved over time but remained relatively low. Early safety data are reassuring. Continued surveillance and larger multisite evaluations are needed to support national program monitoring and integration.

title: Low Cord Blood Titers Are Associated with Prolonged Maternal RSV Antibody Half-Lives in Preterm Infants
abstract: Abstract Background Preterm infants are at higher risk of severe RSV infection, partially because of reduced placental transfer of maternal antibodies (Abs). Increased risk of severe infection persists in the first year of life. This study evaluates the postnatal kinetics of RSV neutralizing antibodies in preterm and full-term infants born to unvaccinated mothers. Methods We enrolled infants with a gestational age (GA) of 24-42 weeks born in hospital from RSV-unvaccinated mothers. Serum was collected at birth (cord blood), 1–2 weeks, and 4–8 weeks. Linear mixed-effects models were used to estimate half-lives of RSV-neutralizing Abs in relation to GA and cord blood titer. Analyses were repeated for total serum IgG1 to confirm the robustness of our findings. Results Of 169 infants, 95 were born preterm (<37 weeks GA, including 53 neonates <32 weeks GA). Premature birth was related to prolonged half-life of RSV-neutralizing Abs (∼79 days very preterm to ∼30 days in term infants). The inverse association between gestational age and antibody half-life was largely accounted for by an inverse association between cord blood Ab levels and Ab half-life. A doubling in cord blood titers led to a reduction in half-life of ∼20% for RSV neutralizing Abs and ∼32% for IgG1. Conclusions Postnatal antibody half-life depends on starting levels: higher titers decline faster. If our observation would be replicated for vaccine-induced Abs, the difference in vaccine protection between preterm and term infants may be smaller than anticipated.

title: Misdiagnosis of bronchiolitis and misuse of antibiotics - experience from the largest paediatric hospital of Bangladesh.
abstract: Background Bronchiolitis remains the commonest acute lower respiratory tract infection in younger children globally. Bronchiolitis is often misdiagnosed as World Health Organization (WHO)-classified pneumonia due to closely related clinical manifestations. Our primary objective was to assess the prevalence of viral bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia, and the secondary objective was to evaluate their management. Methods This was a prospective observational study. Infants (aged Results PCR of NPA of 60 WHO-classified pneumonia cases yielded RSV in 41 (68%) who had pertinent clinical symptoms and signs suggestive of bronchiolitis, attested by benign chest radiography (85%). Further, their mean (x̄) and standard deviation (SD) complete blood count (x̄ = 15,488; SD = 1874/cm) with x̄ = 36% (SD = 11) neutrophil) and C-reactive protein (x̄ = 4.49 (5.88) mg/L cut off reference value >5 mg/L) were indicative more as non-bacterial infections favouring RSV bronchiolitis. In contrast, all 19 non-RSV cases did not differ in clinical findings, as attested by haematological, microbiological and radiographical features, suggesting bronchiolitis-like illness, further supported by disease outcome, discharge pattern and LOS (x̄ = 4.7; SD = 2.29) days). Nevertheless, antibiotics were given in 95% of all 60 cases. Conclusions There was a high proportion of bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia, and antimicrobials were prescribed to treat those cases. The findings need the attention of policymakers to address the overlap between WHO-classified pneumonia and bronchiolitis and minimise the potential overuse of antibiotics.

Our primary objective was to assess the prevalence of viral bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia, and the secondary objective was to evaluate their management. METHODS: This was a prospective observational study. Infants (aged 5 mg/L) were indicative more as non-bacterial infections favouring RSV bronchiolitis. In contrast, all 19 non-RSV cases did not differ in clinical findings, as attested by haematological, microbiological and radiographical features, suggesting bronchiolitis-like illness, further supported by disease outcome, discharge pattern and LOS (x̄ = 4.7; SD = 2.29) days). Nevertheless, antibiotics were given in 95% of all 60 cases. CONCLUSIONS: There was a high proportion of bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia, and antimicrobials were prescribed to treat those cases. The findings need the attention of policymakers to address the overlap between WHO-classified pneumonia and bronchiolitis and minimise the potential overuse of antibiotics.

Bronchiolitis is often misdiagnosed as World Health Organization (WHO)-classified pneumonia due to closely related clinical manifestations. analysis.research_question_and_background: Bronchiolitis is frequently misdiagnosed as WHO-classified pneumonia due to overlapping clinical features, leading to unnecessary antibiotic use. The study aimed to quantify the prevalence of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)-associated bronchiolitis among infants classified with pneumonia and to evaluate their clinical management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a prospective observational study conducted in a paediatric hospital in Bangladesh. It included 60 infants aged under 2 years who were classified with WHO-defined pneumonia. Nasopharyngeal aspirates were collected for RSV testing.
analysis.methods: The study used PCR testing of nasopharyngeal aspirates to detect RSV. Clinical management data were collected, including antibiotic prescription practices. Haematological parameters and chest radiography were assessed to differentiate bronchiolitis from pneumonia.
analysis.main_results: PCR testing identified RSV in 41 of 60 cases (68%), all of whom had clinical features consistent with bronchiolitis and benign chest radiographs (85%). Non-RSV cases (19/60) showed similar clinical and radiographic features, suggesting bronchiolitis-like illness. Antibiotics were prescribed in 95% of all 60 cases despite RSV positivity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The high proportion of RSV-associated bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia cases highlights diagnostic challenges and contributes to antibiotic overuse. The study underscores the need for improved differentiation between bronchiolitis and pneumonia to guide appropriate treatment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support targeted surveillance for RSV in infants with pneumonia-like symptoms to reduce unnecessary antibiotic prescriptions. This could inform national guidelines on respiratory infection management in resource-limited settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-centre design and small sample size, which may affect generalisability. The lack of a control group and reliance on observational data reduce the strength of causal inferences about antibiotic overuse.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective observational study from a large paediatric hospital in Bangladesh assessed the prevalence of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)-associated bronchiolitis among 60 infants classified with WHO-defined pneumonia. PCR testing of nasopharyngeal aspirates detected RSV in 68% of cases, with clinical and radiographic features consistent with bronchiolitis. Despite this, antibiotics were prescribed in 95% of cases, indicating significant diagnostic misclassification and antimicrobial misuse. The study highlights the overlap between bronchiolitis and pneumonia and calls for improved diagnostic strategies to reduce unnecessary antibiotic use.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于临床特征重叠,毛细支气管炎 经常被误诊为 WHO 分类的肺炎,导致不必要的抗生素使用。该研究旨在量化肺炎婴儿中 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 相关 毛细支气管炎 的 患病率 并评估其临床管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是在孟加拉国一家儿科医院进行的一项前瞻性观察研究。其中包括 60 名 2 岁以下婴儿,他们被归类为世界卫生组织定义的肺炎。收集鼻咽抽吸物用于 RSV 检测。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用鼻咽抽吸物的 PCR 检测来检测 RSV。收集临床管理数据,包括抗生素处方实践。评估血液学参数和胸片以区分 毛细支气管炎 和肺炎。
elements_zh.main_results: PCR 检测在 60 例病例中发现了 41 例 (68%) 存在 RSV,所有病例的临床特征均符合 毛细支气管炎 和良性胸部 X 光片 (85%)。非 RSV 病例 (19/60) 显示出相似的临床和影像学特征,提示 毛细支气管炎 样疾病。尽管 RSV 呈阳性,但在所有 60 例病例中,95% 的患者都服用了抗生素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: WHO 分类的肺炎病例中 RSV 相关 毛细支气管炎 的比例很高,凸显了诊断挑战,并导致抗生素过度使用。该研究强调需要改进 毛细支气管炎 和肺炎之间的区分,以指导适当的 治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持针对有肺炎样症状的婴儿进行 RSV 针对性 监测 治疗,以减少不必要的抗生素处方。这可以为资源有限环境中呼吸道感染管理的国家指南提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其单中心设计和小样本量而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。缺乏对照组和对观察数据的依赖降低了关于抗生素过度使用的因果推论的强度。

title: The Epidemiological and Economic Burden of Vaccine-Preventable Respiratory Diseases Among Adults Aged 65 Years and Older in the Nordic Countries
abstract: Background: Despite the increasing availability of tailored vaccines, vaccine-preventable respiratory diseases (VPRDs), including influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), COVID-19, and pneumococcal disease (PD), continue to impose a significant health and economic burden. This study assessed the epidemiological and economic burden of VPRD among adults aged ≥65 across four Nordic countries (Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Finland). Methods: Data on incidence, hospital admissions, and mortality were obtained from national statistics (week 21, 2024–week 20, 2025) and supplemented with peer-reviewed literature. A static model was developed to quantify epidemiological and economic burden associated with VPRD during the 2024/2025 winter season. Results: During the 2024/2025 season, VPRD resulted in approximately 830,000 symptomatic cases, 60,300 hospital admissions, and 7750 deaths across the Nordic countries. COVID-19 showed the highest estimated incidence and numbers of hospital admissions, followed by influenza, PD, and RSV. Mortality was comparable between COVID-19 and influenza, followed by PD and RSV. Annual healthcare costs were approximately €1132 million, with productivity losses constituting an additional 7%. Conclusions: Despite national vaccination efforts, VPRDs remain a major health and economic burden in the Nordic countries. Strengthening immunization programs through improved vaccine uptake, broader coverage, and use of advanced vaccines may contribute to further reducing this burden.

analysis.summary_en: This study quantified the 2024/2025 burden of vaccine-preventable respiratory diseases among adults aged 65 and older in four Nordic countries using a static model that integrated national statistics and literature. Despite national vaccination efforts, the authors concluded that RSV and other VPRDs remain major health and economic burdens, emphasizing the need for improved vaccine uptake, broader coverage, and advanced vaccines. The static model and reliance on aggregated data limit precision, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

title: A network-driven antiviral discovery pipeline for emerging RNA viruses: a critical perspective from the Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de Antivirales (RMDA).
abstract: INTRODUCTION: RNA viruses impose a disproportionate burden of emerging and reemerging infectious diseases in Latin America, yet antiviral discovery in the region remains fragmented, target-limited, and frequently disconnected from translational pathways. This perspective discusses the Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de Antivirales (RMDA) as a network-driven model to organize antiviral discovery against clinically relevant RNA viruses. AREAS COVERED: The authors describe the conceptual architecture of RMDA, a multi-institutional Mexican initiative that integrates computational prioritization, cell-based antiviral evaluation under BSL-2/BSL-3 conditions, mechanistic virology, assessment of pharmacological synergy, in vivo validation, and clinical linkage through healthcare systems such as the Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social. The framework is supported by prior work from participating groups on host-directed and virus-directed candidates, including metabolic modulators, lipid-lowering agents, nuclear transport inhibitors, natural products, polyphenols, melatonin, and rational drug combinations evaluated against dengue virus, Zika virus, SARS-CoV-2, respiratory syncytial virus, and related RNA viruses. EXPERT OPINION: RMDA provides a scalable and regionally adaptable model for antiviral drug discovery in low- and middle-income settings. By aligning distributed expertise, standardized workflows, and translational decision points, this framework may accelerate candidate prioritization, reduce duplication, and strengthen preparedness against RNA virus threats in Mexico and Latin America.

title_zh: 网络驱动的 抗病毒药物 新兴 RNA 病毒发现管道:来自 Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de 抗病毒药物 (RMDA) 的关键视角。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: RNA viruses impose a disproportionate burden of emerging and reemerging infectious diseases in Latin America, yet antiviral discovery in the region remains fragmented, target-limited, and frequently disconnected from translational pathways. This perspective discusses the Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de Antivirales (RMDA) as a network-driven model to organize antiviral discovery against clinically relevant RNA viruses. AREAS COVERED: The authors describe the conceptual architecture of RMDA, a multi-institutional Mexican initiative that integrates computational prioritization, cell-based antiviral evaluation under BSL-2/BSL-3 conditions, mechanistic virology, assessment of pharmacological synergy, in vivo validation, and clinical linkage through healthcare systems such as the Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social. The framework is supported by prior work from participating groups on host-directed and virus-directed candidates, including metabolic modulators, lipid-lowering agents, nuclear transport inhibitors, natural products, polyphenols, melatonin, and rational drug combinations evaluated against dengue virus, Zika virus, SARS-CoV-2, respiratory syncytial virus, and related RNA viruses. EXPERT OPINION: RMDA provides a scalable and regionally adaptable model for antiviral drug discovery in low- and middle-income settings. By aligning distributed expertise, standardized workflows, and translational decision points, this framework may accelerate candidate prioritization, reduce duplication, and strengthen preparedness against RNA virus threats in Mexico and Latin America.
abstract_zh: 简介:RNA 病毒对拉丁美洲新出现和重新出现的传染病造成了不成比例的负担,但该地区的 抗病毒药物 发现仍然支离破碎、目标有限,并且经常与转化途径脱节。本视角讨论了 Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de 抗病毒药物 (RMDA) 作为网络驱动模型来组织针对临床相关 RNA 病毒的 抗病毒药物 发现。涵盖领域:作者描述了 RMDA 的概念架构,这是一项墨西哥多机构倡议,整合了计算优先级、BSL-2/BSL-3 条件下基于细胞的 抗病毒药物 评估、机械病毒学、药理学协同评估、体内验证以及通过医疗保健系统(例如 Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social)的临床联系。该框架得到了参与小组先前关于 宿主 导向和病毒导向候选药物的工作的支持,包括代谢调节剂、降脂剂、核转运抑制剂、天然产物、多酚、褪黑激素以及针对登革热病毒、寨卡病毒、SARS-CoV-2、呼吸道合胞病毒 和相关 RNA 病毒进行评估的合理药物组合。专家意见:RMDA 为中低收入环境中的 抗病毒药物 药物发现提供了一个可扩展且区域适应性强的模型。通过协调分布式专业知识、标准化工作流程和转化决策点,该框架可以加速候选者的优先级排序、减少重复并加强墨西哥和拉丁美洲针对 RNA 病毒威胁的准备。

title: Epitranscriptomic regulation of host-virus interactions.
abstract: RNA chemical modifications, collectively termed the epitranscriptome, are now recognized as critical regulators of gene expression that influence host antiviral responses. These modifications are frequently co-opted by both RNA and DNA viruses to enhance their replication and evade immune detection. This review explores key RNA modifications, principal modifying enzymes, emphasizing how these modifications regulate mRNA stability, translation, and innate immune recognition of both host and viral RNAs. Furthermore, this review examines how viruses, including DENV, SARS-CoV-2, HIV-1, HCV, RSV, and HSV, manipulate host RNA modification systems. Overall, this review highlights the epitranscriptome as a dynamic interface in host-virus interactions and underscores its potential as a target for antiviral therapeutic development.
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述强调了表观转录组作为 宿主-病毒相互作用中的动态界面,并强调了其作为 抗病毒药物 治疗开发目标的潜力。它强调 RNA 修饰在调节 mRNA 稳定性、翻译和免疫识别中的作用。

title: Deadbolt Drug Discovery: Locking the Door to Class 1 Viral Entry by Small Molecules.
abstract: The continued emergence of viral pathogens underscores the need for novel antiviral therapeutics with improved efficacy. Small-molecule inhibitors of viral entry are attractive antiviral agents because they block the virus at its earliest step, preventing the virus from entering host cells and causing downstream damage. Some of the viruses of greatest concern for human health, such as human immunodeficiency virus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza virus, Ebola virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2, and Lassa virus, encode Class 1 fusion proteins which mediate membrane fusion and viral entry. In this review, we highlight recent advances in the discovery and development of small-molecule entry inhibitors reported over the past five years that target viruses encoding Class 1 fusion proteins.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the development of small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins in respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) to prevent viral entry into host cells. The central question is whether these inhibitors can serve as effective antiviral therapeutics for RSV-related diseases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of recent advances in small-molecule entry inhibitors targeting viruses with Class 1 fusion proteins, including RSV, over the past five years. It does not report specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins have shown promise in preventing viral entry, which is a critical early step in the infection process. These inhibitors are considered attractive antiviral agents due to their potential to block downstream damage.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while there is growing interest in small-molecule entry inhibitors, the evidence is still limited and heterogeneous. There is a lack of comprehensive data on their efficacy across different RSV strains and populations, and further research is needed to address these gaps.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should prioritize the development and testing of small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins in RSV. This includes evaluating their effectiveness against RSV-A and RSV-B strains and exploring their potential for broader antiviral applications.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins in respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) to prevent viral entry into host cells. It emphasizes the importance of these inhibitors in blocking the earliest stages of infection, thereby reducing downstream damage. The review highlights recent advances in this area over the past five years but also identifies gaps in the evidence, particularly regarding efficacy across different RSV strains and populations. The findings suggest that further research is needed to develop and test these inhibitors for broader antiviral applications, especially in addressing the challenges posed by RSV-A and RSV-B strains.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是开发针对 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 中 1 类融合蛋白的小分子抑制剂,以防止病毒进入 宿主 细胞。核心问题是这些抑制剂是否可以作为 RSV 相关疾病的有效 抗病毒药物 疗法。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对过去五年来针对具有 1 类融合蛋白(包括 RSV)的病毒的小分子进入抑制剂的最新进展进行了叙述性综合。它不报告特定的数据库、搜索日期或荟萃分析方法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述强调,针对 1 类融合蛋白的小分子抑制剂在防止病毒进入方面显示出前景,这是感染过程中关键的早期步骤。这些抑制剂被认为是有吸引力的 抗病毒药物 药物,因为它们具有阻止下游损伤的潜力。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,尽管人们对小分子进入抑制剂的兴趣日益浓厚,但证据仍然有限且异质。目前缺乏关于其在不同 RSV 毒株和群体中的功效的全面数据,需要进一步研究来解决这些差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议未来的研究应优先开发和测试针对 RSV 中 1 类融合蛋白的小分子抑制剂。这包括评估它们对 RSV-A 和 RSV-B 菌株的有效性,并探索它们在更广泛的 抗病毒药物 应用中的潜力。

title: Immune correlates of protection against RSV following Ad26.RSV.preF–RSV preF vaccination of adults aged >60 years
abstract: Abstract Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of respiratory illness and there is no universally accepted serological correlate of protection (CoP). We evaluated serum pre-fusion immunoglobulin G binding (preF-IgG) and RSV-A2 neutralizing antibodies (RSV-nAb) in adults aged >60 years following vaccination with investigational Ad26.RSV.preF–RSV preF vaccine. PreF-IgG and RSV-nAb measured pre-vaccination (Day 1) and Day 15 post-vaccination were assessed as CoPs against RSV-mediated acute respiratory infection (ARI) and lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD). An increase in both preF-IgG and RSV-nAb at Day 15 was significantly associated with reduced occurrence of RSV-mediated ARI and LRTD during follow-up. Based on controlled vaccine-efficacy curves and Prentice criteria, both markers were identified as CoPs for RSV-mediated ARI and LRTD. These results were validated using samples from a second randomized, phase 3 efficacy trial. Comprehensive profiling of preF-specific antibody responses showed that preF IgG3 and IgG2 may also contribute to protection from RSV.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of respiratory illness in older adults, yet no universally accepted serological correlate of protection (CoP) exists. The study aimed to identify immune markers that predict protection against RSV-mediated disease following vaccination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated adults aged over 60 years who received the investigational Ad26.RSV.preF–RSV preF vaccine. Serum pre-fusion immunoglobulin G binding (preF-IgG) and RSV-A2 neutralizing antibodies (RSV-nAb) were measured pre-vaccination and 15 days post-vaccination.
analysis.methods: PreF-IgG and RSV-nAb levels were assessed as correlates of protection against RSV-mediated acute respiratory infection (ARI) and lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD). The association between these markers and disease outcomes was analyzed using controlled vaccine-efficacy curves and Prentice criteria.
analysis.main_results: An increase in both preF-IgG and RSV-nAb at Day 15 was significantly associated with reduced occurrence of RSV-mediated ARI and LRTD during follow-up. Comprehensive profiling indicated that preF IgG3 and IgG2 subclasses may also contribute to protection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors identified preF-IgG and RSV-nAb as serological correlates of protection against RSV-mediated ARI and LRTD, validating these markers using samples from a second randomized phase 3 efficacy trial. The study further suggested that specific preF IgG subclasses may enhance protective immunity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support the use of preF-IgG and RSV-nAb as measurable immune markers for vaccine efficacy and could guide the development of improved RSV vaccines and vaccination strategies in older adults.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to abstract-level data and lacks detailed methodological descriptions or numerical effect sizes. While the validation in a phase 3 trial strengthens the findings, the strength of evidence is moderate due to the absence of comprehensive methodological and statistical reporting.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated immune correlates of protection against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in adults aged over 60 years following vaccination with the Ad26.RSV.preF–RSV preF vaccine. The research addressed the lack of universally accepted serological correlates of protection for RSV by evaluating serum pre-fusion immunoglobulin G binding (preF-IgG) and RSV-A2 neutralizing antibodies (RSV-nAb) as potential markers. Pre-vaccination and Day 15 post-vaccination measurements of these markers were analyzed for their association with reduced RSV-mediated acute respiratory infection (ARI) and lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD). The study found that increases in preF-IgG and RSV-nAb at Day 15 were significantly linked to protection against RSV-mediated disease, with additional evidence suggesting a role for preF IgG3 and IgG2 subclasses. The findings were validated using samples from a second randomized phase 3 efficacy trial, supporting the potential of these markers for vaccine evaluation. The study highlights the significance of these immune markers for guiding RSV vaccine development and vaccination strategies in older adults.

title_zh: 60 岁以上成年人 Ad26.RSV.preF–RSV preF 疫苗接种 后 RSV 保护的免疫相关性
source_body_en: Abstract Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of respiratory illness and there is no universally accepted serological correlate of protection (CoP). We evaluated serum pre-fusion immunoglobulin G binding (preF-IgG) and RSV-A2 neutralizing antibodies (RSV-nAb) in adults aged >60 years following vaccination with investigational Ad26.RSV.preF–RSV preF vaccine. PreF-IgG and RSV-nAb measured pre-vaccination (Day 1) and Day 15 post-vaccination were assessed as CoPs against RSV-mediated acute respiratory infection (ARI) and lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD). An increase in both preF-IgG and RSV-nAb at Day 15 was significantly associated with reduced occurrence of RSV-mediated ARI and LRTD during follow-up. Based on controlled vaccine-efficacy curves and Prentice criteria, both markers were identified as CoPs for RSV-mediated ARI and LRTD. These results were validated using samples from a second randomized, phase 3 efficacy trial. Comprehensive profiling of preF-specific antibody responses showed that preF IgG3 and IgG2 may also contribute to protection from RSV.

title: Whole-Genome Sequencing of RSV and Phylogeographic Assessment of Viral Importations into Russia
abstract: Lower respiratory tract infections caused by the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) pose a major global public health challenge. The use of next-generation sequencing technologies enables detailed monitoring of viral genetic variability, which is crucial for evaluating the efficacy of immunoprophylactic measures. In this study, whole-genome sequencing of RSV was performed on 106 samples collected in the Russian Federation between September 2021 and April 2025. Three NGS platforms were employed: Illumina MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore Technologies MinION, and Qitan Tech QNome-3841. Using discrete phylogeographic methods, we estimated a minimum of 45 introduction events into Russia for RSV-A and 39 for RSV-B among the genomes included in the analysis. Most events were represented by a single Russian genome. These results indicate recurrent introductions of RSV into Russia from abroad. Given the limited genomic sampling available, most of these introductions were not associated with detectable transmission within the country.

title_original: Whole-Genome Sequencing of RSV and Phylogeographic Assessment of Viral Importations into Russia

analysis.research_question_and_background: Lower respiratory tract infections caused by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) represent a major global public health challenge, and the study aimed to address gaps in understanding RSV genetic variability and importation dynamics into Russia.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Whole-genome sequencing of RSV was performed on 106 samples collected in the Russian Federation between September 2021 and April 2025, employing discrete phylogeographic methods to assess viral introductions.
analysis.methods: Three next-generation sequencing platforms were used: Illumina MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore Technologies MinION, and Qitan Tech QNome-3841, with whole-genome sequencing applied to characterize RSV genetic diversity.
analysis.main_results: A minimum of 45 introduction events for RSV-A and 39 for RSV-B were estimated, with most events represented by a single Russian genome, indicating recurrent introductions from abroad.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate recurrent RSV introductions into Russia from foreign sources, highlighting the role of genomic surveillance in tracking viral importations and informing public health responses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study underscores the value of whole-genome sequencing for monitoring RSV genetic variability and importation patterns, which can guide surveillance strategies and immunoprophylactic measures.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The limited genomic sampling restricts detection of transmission chains within Russia, reducing the ability to fully characterize domestic spread and potentially underestimating introduction events.

analysis.summary_en: This study used whole-genome sequencing of 106 RSV samples collected in Russia from 2021 to 2025 to assess viral genetic variability and importation dynamics. Three NGS platforms were employed to sequence RSV genomes, enabling phylogeographic analysis. The authors estimated at least 45 introductions of RSV-A and 39 of RSV-B into Russia, with most events represented by single genomes, suggesting recurrent importations from abroad. These findings highlight the utility of genomic surveillance for tracking RSV introductions and informing public health strategies. However, limited genomic sampling likely constrained detection of domestic transmission chains, limiting the completeness of the phylogeographic assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 引起的下呼吸道感染是一项重大的全球公共卫生挑战,该研究旨在解决了解 RSV 基因变异和俄罗斯输入动态方面的差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2021 年 9 月至 2025 年 4 月期间在俄罗斯联邦收集的 106 个样本进行了 RSV 全 基因组 测序,采用离散系统发育地理学方法来评估病毒引入。

title_zh: RSV 的全 基因组 测序和俄罗斯病毒输入的谱系地理学评估
source_body_en: Lower respiratory tract infections caused by the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) pose a major global public health challenge. The use of next-generation sequencing technologies enables detailed monitoring of viral genetic variability, which is crucial for evaluating the efficacy of immunoprophylactic measures. In this study, whole-genome sequencing of RSV was performed on 106 samples collected in the Russian Federation between September 2021 and April 2025. Three NGS platforms were employed: Illumina MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore Technologies MinION, and Qitan Tech QNome-3841. Using discrete phylogeographic methods, we estimated a minimum of 45 introduction events into Russia for RSV-A and 39 for RSV-B among the genomes included in the analysis. Most events were represented by a single Russian genome. These results indicate recurrent introductions of RSV into Russia from abroad. Given the limited genomic sampling available, most of these introductions were not associated with detectable transmission within the country.

title: Bidirectional changes in recorded pediatric asthma diagnoses with respiratory virus activity: A nationwide interrupted time-series analysis in Japan.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Early-life respiratory infections are associated with subsequent asthma development; however, whether respiratory viruses contribute to asthma onset or merely unmask pre-existing susceptibility remains unclear. The COVID-19 pandemic's non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) suppressed respiratory viruses, followed by their resurgence, offering a natural experiment. We examined whether these population-level changes in respiratory virus activity were associated with changes in newly recorded pediatric asthma diagnoses. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide interrupted time-series study using Japan's National Database of Health Insurance Claims, covering approximately 99% of the population. Segmented negative binomial regression with two intervention points-NPI implementation (T1: March 2020) and COVID-19 reclassification (T2: May 2023)-was applied to monthly counts of newly recorded asthma diagnoses among children aged under 19 years (January 2018-March 2024), with atopic dermatitis as negative control. Age-stratified/sex-stratified analyses and exploratory ecological analyses of pathogen-specific associations were conducted. RESULTS: Among 10,508,387 new asthma diagnoses, incidence declined significantly following NPI implementation (incidence rate ratio [IRR] 0.511, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.422-0.620) and rebounded following NPI relaxation (IRR 1.395, 95% CI:1.120-1.737). Atopic dermatitis showed attenuated changes at both points. Rate differences were greatest in infants (0-1 years) at T1 and school-aged children (5-9 years) at T2. Rhinovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae, but not SARS-CoV-2, correlated with asthma diagnoses in ecological analyses. CONCLUSIONS: Newly recorded pediatric asthma diagnoses showed bidirectional changes that paralleled respiratory virus suppression and resurgence, compatible with a possible contributory role of respiratory infections, particularly among infants and school-aged children.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed whether respiratory virus activity contributes to pediatric asthma onset or merely unmasks pre-existing susceptibility, noting that early-life respiratory infections are linked to subsequent asthma development but the causal role of specific viruses remains unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A nationwide interrupted time-series study was conducted in Japan using the National Database of Health Insurance Claims, covering approximately 99% of the population, with monthly counts of newly recorded pediatric asthma diagnoses among children under 19 years from January 2018 to March 2024.
analysis.methods: Segmented negative binomial regression with two intervention points—NPI implementation in March 2020 and COVID-19 reclassification in May 2023—was applied to analyze asthma diagnosis trends, including age-stratified and sex-stratified analyses, with atopic dermatitis as a negative control and exploratory ecological analyses of pathogen-specific associations.
analysis.main_results: Among 10,508,387 new asthma diagnoses, incidence declined significantly following NPI implementation (incidence rate ratio [IRR] 0.511, 95% CI 0.422–0.620) and rebounded after NPI relaxation (IRR 1.395, 95% CI 1.120–1.737), with the greatest rate differences in infants (0–1 years) at T1 and school-aged children (5–9 years) at T2.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the bidirectional changes in pediatric asthma diagnoses as compatible with a possible contributory role of respiratory infections, particularly rhinovirus, RSV, influenza, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae, highlighting the novelty of leveraging pandemic-related NPIs as a natural experiment to assess virus-asthma associations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings cautiously suggest that respiratory virus activity may influence asthma onset in children, particularly infants and school-aged groups, informing surveillance strategies and future research into infection-mediated asthma triggers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s ecological design and reliance on recorded diagnoses limit causal inference, and the absence of direct pathogen detection in asthma cases weakens specificity; the evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This nationwide interrupted time-series analysis in Japan examined whether changes in respiratory virus activity during the COVID-19 pandemic were associated with pediatric asthma diagnoses. Using Japan’s National Database of Health Insurance Claims covering 99% of the population, the study analyzed monthly counts of new asthma diagnoses among children under 19 years from January 2018 to March 2024. Segmented negative binomial regression with two intervention points—NPI implementation in March 2020 and COVID-19 reclassification in May 2023—revealed a significant decline in asthma diagnoses following NPIs (IRR 0.511, 95% CI 0.422–0.620) and a rebound after relaxation (IRR 1.395, 95% CI 1.120–1.737). The greatest rate differences were observed in infants at NPI implementation and school-aged children at reclassification. Ecological analyses linked rhinovirus, RSV, influenza, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae to asthma diagnoses, while SARS-CoV-2 showed no correlation. The authors interpret these bidirectional changes as compatible with a contributory role of respiratory infections in asthma onset, particularly among vulnerable age groups. The study’s ecological design and reliance on recorded diagnoses limit causal inference, and the evidence strength is assessed as moderate.

elements_zh.methods: 采用具有两个干预点(2020 年 3 月 NPI 实施和 2023 年 5 月 COVID-19 重新分类)的分段负二项回归来分析哮喘 诊断 趋势,包括年龄分层和性别分层分析,以特应性皮炎作为阴性对照,并对病原体特异性关联进行探索性生态分析。
elements_zh.main_results: Among 10,508,387 new asthma diagnoses, incidence declined significantly following NPI implementation (incidence rate ratio [IRR] 0.511, 95% CI 0.422–0.620) and rebounded after NPI relaxation (IRR 1.395, 95% CI 1.120–1.737), with the greatest rate differences in infants (0–1 years) at T1 and school-aged children (5–9 years) at T2.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果谨慎地表明,呼吸道病毒活动可能会影响儿童,特别是婴儿和学龄群体的哮喘发作,为 监测 策略和未来对感染介导的哮喘触发因素的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的生态设计和对记录诊断的依赖限制了因果推断,并且在哮喘病例中缺乏直接病原体检测削弱了特异性;由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

title: Safety Profile of the Bivalent RSVpreF Vaccine (Abrysvo®) Administered During Pregnancy: An Active Real-World Pharmacovigilance Study in Panama, 2025
abstract: Background/Objectives. Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is an important cause of acute lower respiratory infection in infants. Panama introduced the bivalent prefusion F vaccine (RSVpreF) for administration between 32.0 and 36.6 weeks of gestation in July 2025. In this tropical setting, respiratory viruses are detected throughout the year, with RSV activity increasing during the rainy season. We characterized self-reported maternal and neonatal events and outcomes to generate early post-introduction real-world safety evidence from Central America. This retrospective descriptive observational study included women aged 18 years or older vaccinated with RSVpreF between 32.0 and 36.6 weeks of gestation from July through December 2025 and recruited from January through July 2026. Structured telephone, virtual, or in-person interviews were used. We calculated absolute and relative frequencies and 95% Wilson confidence intervals (CIs). Of 225 questionnaires obtained, 200 were eligible for analysis. Mean maternal age was 28.1 years (SD 6.4). At least one reaction was reported by 55.5% of participants, mainly local; injection-site pain was most frequent (48.0%). At least one obstetric condition was reported by 17.5%, including hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (12.0%). Preterm birth occurred in 2.0% and low birth weight in 2.5%. No fetal or neonatal deaths, thrombocytopenia, paralysis, facial paralysis, or Guillain–Barré syndrome were reported. Jaundice was the most frequent neonatal morbidity (20.0%). In this cohort, self-reported reactogenicity was mainly local, and no unexpected cluster of events was apparent. Participant selection, retrospective self-report, absence of an unvaccinated comparator, and sample size limit risk estimation and detection of uncommon events. The findings provide early active-pharmacovigilance evidence from Central America and support continued surveillance with clinically verified maternal and neonatal outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the real-world safety of the bivalent RSVpreF vaccine (Abrysvo®) administered during pregnancy in Panama. It characterized self-reported maternal and neonatal events among 200 vaccinated women aged 18 years or older who received the vaccine between 32.0 and 36.6 weeks of gestation from July to December 2025. Structured interviews were used to collect data, and frequencies with 95% confidence intervals were calculated. Reactogenicity was mainly local, with 55.5% reporting at least one reaction and injection-site pain in 48.0%. Obstetric conditions occurred in 17.5%, including hypertensive disorders in 12.0%. Neonatal outcomes included preterm birth in 2.0% and low birth weight in 2.5%, while no fetal or neonatal deaths or serious neurological events were reported. The authors concluded that no unexpected safety signals emerged, supporting continued surveillance with clinically verified outcomes.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持继续进行 监测 临床验证的孕产妇和新生儿结局,以监测 疫苗 在现实环境中的安全性。

abstract_zh: 背景/目标。呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是婴儿急性下呼吸道感染的重要原因。巴拿马于 2025 年 7 月引入了二价预输液 F 疫苗 (RSVpreF),用于妊娠 32.0 至 36.6 周之间的给药。在这个热带环境中,呼吸道病毒全年都会检测到,RSV 活性在雨季期间增加。我们对自我报告的孕产妇和新生儿事件和结果进行了描述,以生成来自中美洲的早期引入后真实世界安全证据。这项回顾性描述性观察研究包括 2025 年 7 月至 12 月期间在妊娠 32.0 至 36.6 周期间接种 RSVpreF 的 18 岁或以上女性,并于 2026 年 1 月至 7 月期间招募。采用了结构化电话、虚拟或面对面访谈。我们计算了绝对频率和相对频率以及 95% 威尔逊置信区间 (CI)。在收到的 225 份问卷中,有 200 份符合分析条件。产妇平均年龄为 28.1 岁 (SD 6.4)。55.5% 的参与者至少报告了一种反应,主要是本地参与者;注射部位疼痛最常见(48.0%)。17.5% 的人报告至少一种产科疾病,包括妊娠期高血压疾病 (12.0%)。早产率为 2.0%,低出生体重率为 2.5%。没有胎儿或新生儿死亡、血小板减少、瘫痪、面瘫或吉兰-巴利综合征的报告。黄疸是最常见的新生儿发病率(20.0%)。在此 队列研究 中,自我报告的反应原性主要是局部的,并且没有明显的意外事件群。参与者的选择、回顾性自我报告、缺乏未接种疫苗的比较者以及样本量限制了风险估计和不常见事件的检测。研究结果提供了来自中美洲的早期主动药物警戒证据,并支持继续进行 监测 临床验证的孕产妇和新生儿结局。

title: Trends and outcomes of Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in hospitalized children before, during, and after the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic: a retrospective study in Northeast China, 2018-2023.
abstract: ABSTRACT Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) is the most common form of community-acquired pneumonia, which shows an epidemic interval of 3–7 years. This study was conducted to understand the changing trends in MPP in children hospitalized before and during the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic and determine adverse outcomes and their influencing factors. This was a retrospective cohort study of children aged 28 days to 14 years hospitalized for MPP at our institution between January 2018 and December 2023. Clinical characteristics, adverse outcomes, and associated factors were analyzed using the chi-square test and multivariable logistic regression. A P < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. A total of 17,505 MPP cases were included, with the highest case number (4,619) in 2023. In 2023, the proportion of severe pneumonia was 44.1%, and bronchoscopy usage was 33.5%, both significantly higher than in 2018–2022. Older age, admission during July–December, co-infection with Epstein-Barr virus, chlamydia, or other bacteria, and complications, including pleural effusion, abnormal liver enzymes, acute respiratory distress syndrome, or atelectasis, were associated with bronchoscopy. Older age, admission during October–December, co-infection with respiratory syncytial virus, adenovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, chlamydia, or other bacteria, and complications, including cardiac failure, abnormal liver enzymes, myocardial damage, or anemia, were associated with severe pneumonia. Cases of MPP, severe pneumonia, and those requiring bronchoscopy increased in 2023 compared with the five previous years. Children with MPP were more susceptible to adverse clinical outcomes, which were associated with age, month of admission, co-infection, and complications. IMPORTANCE Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) is a leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia in children. This study analyzed 17,505 hospitalized children in Northeast China from 2018 to 2023 to explore MPP trends before, during, and after the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic. We found a sharp resurgence of MPP in 2023 with higher rates of severe pneumonia, complications, and bronchoscopy use. Key risk factors for adverse outcomes included older age, admission in October–December, viral/bacterial co-infection, and pulmonary or extrapulmonary complications. These findings improve understanding of post-pandemic MPP epidemiology, support early risk stratification, and help optimize clinical management and public health interventions for childhood MPP.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解2019年冠状病毒病大流行之前和期间住院儿童肺炎支原体肺炎(MPP)的变化趋势,并确定不良结局及其影响因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项 队列研究 回顾性研究,对象为 2018 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间在该机构因 MPP 住院的 28 天至 14 岁儿童。分析了 2018 年至 2023 年中国东北地区的 17,505 名住院儿童,以探讨 2019 年冠状病毒病大流行之前、期间和之后的 MPP 趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 使用卡方检验和多变量逻辑回归分析临床特征、不良结果和相关因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 与前五年相比,2023 年 MPP、重症肺炎和需要支气管镜检查的病例有所增加。2023年,重症肺炎比例为44.1%,支气管镜使用率为33.5%,均显着高于2018-2022年。年龄较大、7月至12月入院、合并EB病毒、衣原体或其他细菌感染以及并发症,包括胸腔积液、肝酶异常、急性呼吸窘迫综合征或肺不张,均与支气管镜检查有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为,MPP 将于 2023 年急剧复苏,严重肺炎、并发症和支气管镜使用率更高,这凸显了早期风险分层和优化临床管理的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提高了对大流行后 MPP 流行病学 的理解,支持早期风险分层,并有助于优化儿童 MPP 的临床管理和公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和数据收集中的潜在偏差而受到限制,但由于样本量大和统计分析,证据是强有力的。

title: Etiological composition and epidemiological characteristics of acute respiratory infections in Hebei Province, 2023–2025
abstract: Background Acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs) are a major global public health concern. This study aimed to characterize the pathogen spectrum and epidemiological features of 11 common respiratory pathogens among outpatients and hospitalized patients in Hebei Province. Methods A total of 11,942 patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) or severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) were enrolled from October 2023 to September 2025. Throat swabs, sputum, and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid were collected and screened using a multiplex PCR kit. Age distribution, temporal trends, and coinfection patterns were analyzed. Results The results showed that the pathogen positivity rate among SARI (45.71%) was higher than that among ILI (41.62%); influenza virus (IFV) had the highest detection rate among ILI, whilst Mycoplasma pneumoniae (M. pneumoniae) was the most frequently detected pathogen among SARI; In terms of age distribution: IFV had the highest detection rate across all age groups in ILI; in the 0–4-year-old SARI group, respiratory syncytial virus was predominant; in the 5–14-year-old group, the detection rate of M. pneumoniae reached 43.44 %; and in the group aged 15 years and over, IFV and Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2(SARS-CoV-2) were the predominant pathogens. SARS-CoV-2 were intermittently detected throughout the year, with three waves of epidemic peaks observed. IFV and RSV predominantly emerged during winter and spring, while rhinovirus showed higher activity in summer and autumn. pneumoniae exhibited a high incidence rate initially, which has been declining steadily since the end of 2024.The proportion of multi-pathogen co-infections among positive specimens was 14.88%, the proportion of co-infections among SARI (23.76 %) was significantly higher than that among ILI (9.28 %). pneumoniae and rhinovirus was the most common, followed by human bocavirus, parainfluenza virus and enterovirus, which were also among the pathogens frequently detected in combination. Conclusion This study elucidated the epidemiological characteristics of respiratory pathogens in Hebei Province, providing a scientific basis for the precise prevention and control of ARTIs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs) impose a major global public health burden, and the etiological composition and epidemiological patterns of common respiratory pathogens in Hebei Province were insufficiently characterized before this study.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective surveillance study enrolled 11,942 outpatients and hospitalized patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) or severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) from October 2023 to September 2025 across Hebei Province.
analysis.methods: Throat swabs, sputum, and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid were collected and screened using a multiplex PCR kit; age distribution, temporal trends, and coinfection patterns were analyzed.
analysis.main_results: Among SARI cases the pathogen positivity rate was 45.71% versus 41.62% in ILI; respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) was predominant in the 0–4-year-old SARI group, and RSV showed predominant winter–spring activity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified RSV as a leading cause of SARI in young children and highlighted its seasonal winter–spring predominance, providing new local evidence to inform targeted prevention strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support prioritizing RSV surveillance and prevention in pediatric SARI, particularly in the 0–4-year age group, and can guide local immunization and infection-control policies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s cross-sectional design and reliance on multiplex PCR without confirmatory sequencing limit etiological resolution and causal inference; evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective surveillance study in Hebei Province characterized the pathogen spectrum among 11,942 ILI and SARI patients from October 2023 to September 2025 using multiplex PCR on respiratory specimens. Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) was identified as the predominant pathogen in the 0–4-year-old severe acute respiratory infection group and exhibited clear winter–spring seasonality. The overall pathogen positivity rate was higher in SARI (45.71%) than in ILI (41.62%). These findings provide local evidence to guide RSV-focused prevention and control measures in young children.

elements_zh.methods: 收集咽拭子、痰液和支气管肺泡灌洗液,并使用多重PCR试剂盒进行筛查;分析了年龄分布、时间趋势和合并感染模式。
elements_zh.main_results: SARI 病例中病原体阳性率为 45.71%,而 ILI 病例中病原体阳性率为 41.62%;呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 在0-4岁SARI组中占主导地位,并且RSV表现出冬春季节的主要活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定 RSV 是幼儿 SARI 的主要原因,并强调了其季节性冬春季优势,为有针对性的预防策略提供了新的当地证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在儿科 SARI 中优先考虑 RSV 监测 和预防,特别是在 0-4 岁年龄组,并且可以指导当地的免疫和感染控制政策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的横断面设计和对多重 PCR 的依赖(没有验证性测序)限制了病因解析和因果推断;证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs) impose a major global public health burden, and the etiological composition and epidemiological patterns of common respiratory pathogens in Hebei Province were insufficiently characterized before this study.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A prospective surveillance study enrolled 11,942 outpatients and hospitalized patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) or severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) from October 2023 to September 2025 across Hebei Province.
analysis_en.methods: Throat swabs, sputum, and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid were collected and screened using a multiplex PCR kit; age distribution, temporal trends, and coinfection patterns were analyzed.
analysis_en.main_results: Among SARI cases the pathogen positivity rate was 45.71% versus 41.62% in ILI; respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) was predominant in the 0–4-year-old SARI group, and RSV showed predominant winter–spring activity.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified RSV as a leading cause of SARI in young children and highlighted its seasonal winter–spring predominance, providing new local evidence to inform targeted prevention strategies.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support prioritizing RSV surveillance and prevention in pediatric SARI, particularly in the 0–4-year age group, and can guide local immunization and infection-control policies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s cross-sectional design and reliance on multiplex PCR without confirmatory sequencing limit etiological resolution and causal inference; evidence strength is moderate.

title_zh: 2023-2025年河北省急性呼吸道感染病原学构成及流行病学特征
source_body_en: Background Acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs) are a major global public health concern. This study aimed to characterize the pathogen spectrum and epidemiological features of 11 common respiratory pathogens among outpatients and hospitalized patients in Hebei Province. Methods A total of 11,942 patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) or severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) were enrolled from October 2023 to September 2025. Throat swabs, sputum, and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid were collected and screened using a multiplex PCR kit. Age distribution, temporal trends, and coinfection patterns were analyzed. Results The results showed that the pathogen positivity rate among SARI (45.71%) was higher than that among ILI (41.62%); influenza virus (IFV) had the highest detection rate among ILI, whilst Mycoplasma pneumoniae (M. pneumoniae) was the most frequently detected pathogen among SARI; In terms of age distribution: IFV had the highest detection rate across all age groups in ILI; in the 0–4-year-old SARI group, respiratory syncytial virus was predominant; in the 5–14-year-old group, the detection rate of M. pneumoniae reached 43.44 %; and in the group aged 15 years and over, IFV and Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2(SARS-CoV-2) were the predominant pathogens. SARS-CoV-2 were intermittently detected throughout the year, with three waves of epidemic peaks observed. IFV and RSV predominantly emerged during winter and spring, while rhinovirus showed higher activity in summer and autumn. pneumoniae exhibited a high incidence rate initially, which has been declining steadily since the end of 2024.The proportion of multi-pathogen co-infections among positive specimens was 14.88%, the proportion of co-infections among SARI (23.76 %) was significantly higher than that among ILI (9.28 %). pneumoniae and rhinovirus was the most common, followed by human bocavirus, parainfluenza virus and enterovirus, which were also among the pathogens frequently detected in combination. Conclusion This study elucidated the epidemiological characteristics of respiratory pathogens in Hebei Province, providing a scientific basis for the precise prevention and control of ARTIs.

title: Unreacted RSV Polymerase Structures Expand the Post-Translocation Landscape of the Nucleotide Addition Cycle
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) RNA synthesis relies on RNA-dependent RNA polymerase, a complex composed of the L and P proteins. We recently resolved four major structural states of the RSV nucleotide addition cycle (NAC), establishing a framework for viral RNA elongation. However, reaction-derived complexes are influenced by catalytic efficiency and intermediate occupancy and may incompletely sample the NAC conformational landscape. Here, we report two cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of unreacted RSV polymerase bound to a post-translocation RNA product mimic. One structure closely recapitulates the previously determined reaction-derived post-translocation state, demonstrating that the canonical architecture can be recovered independently of nucleotide incorporation. The second structure reveals an additional post-translocation intermediate that retains the same RNA register and vacant +1 product-binding site while adopting a two-domain L organization. Structural comparisons further identify localized rearrangements near the catalytic center, including changes in the motif A loop and supporting helix. Together, these findings expand the structural landscape of the RSV post-translocation stage and refine the current NAC model. More broadly, our results highlight unreacted state-matched complexes as a complementary approach to reaction-derived structures for capturing more complete structural snapshots of dynamic reaction cycles.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved structural analysis of unreacted RSV polymerase using cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) to capture post-translocation RNA product mimic-bound states. The research was conducted in a laboratory setting and focused on the RSV polymerase complex.
analysis.methods: The researchers used cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) to determine two structures of unreacted RSV polymerase bound to a post-translocation RNA product mimic. Structural comparisons were performed to identify localized rearrangements near the catalytic center.
analysis.main_results: Two cryo-EM structures of unreacted RSV polymerase bound to a post-translocation RNA product mimic were reported. One structure closely recapitulates the previously determined reaction-derived post-translocation state, while the second reveals an additional intermediate with a two-domain L organization.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings expand the structural landscape of the RSV post-translocation stage and refine the current NAC model. The study highlights unreacted state-matched complexes as a complementary approach to reaction-derived structures for capturing more complete structural snapshots of dynamic reaction cycles.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the structural dynamics of RSV polymerase, which could inform the development of antiviral strategies targeting RNA synthesis. They also contribute to a better understanding of the viral replication process.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to structural analysis and does not include functional or clinical data. The evidence is based on cryo-EM structures and is considered moderate in strength due to the absence of direct biochemical or biological validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) RNA 合成依赖于 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶,这是一种由 L 和 P 蛋白组成的复合物。该研究旨在扩大对 RSV 核苷酸添加循环 (NAC) 易位后阶段的结构理解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 对未反应的 RSV 聚合酶进行结构分析,以捕获易位后 RNA 产物模拟结合状态。该研究是在实验室环境中进行的,重点是 RSV 聚合酶复合物。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 确定了与易位后 RNA 产物模拟物结合的未反应 RSV 聚合酶的两种结构。进行结构比较以确定催化中心附近的局部重排。
elements_zh.main_results: 报道了与易位后 RNA 产物模拟物结合的未反应 RSV 聚合酶的两种冷冻电镜结构。一种结构紧密地概括了先前确定的反应衍生的易位后状态,而第二种结构则揭示了具有双结构域 L 组织的附加中间体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现扩展了 RSV 易位后阶段的结构景观并完善了当前的 NAC 模型。该研究强调未反应的状态匹配复合物作为反应衍生结构的补充方法,用于捕获动态反应循环的更完整的结构快照。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 RSV 聚合酶结构动力学的深入了解,这可以为针对 RNA 合成的 抗病毒药物 策略的开发提供信息。它们还有助于更好地了解病毒复制过程。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于结构分析,不包括功能或临床数据。该证据基于冷冻电镜结构,由于缺乏直接的生化或生物学验证,因此被认为强度中等。

abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) RNA 合成依赖于 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶,这是一种由 L 和 P 蛋白组成的复合物。我们最近解决了 RSV 核苷酸添加循环 (NAC) 的四种主要结构状态,建立了病毒 RNA 延伸的框架。然而,反应衍生的复合物受到催化效率和中间占有率的影响,并且可能不完全采样 NAC 构象景观。在这里,我们报告了两种未反应的 RSV 聚合酶与易位后 RNA 产物模拟物结合的冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构。一种结构紧密地概括了先前确定的反应衍生的易位后状态,表明可以独立于核苷酸掺入来恢复规范结构。第二种结构揭示了一个额外的易位后中间体,它保留了相同的RNA寄存器和空的+1产物结合位点,同时采用双结构域L组织。结构比较进一步确定了催化中心附近的局部重排,包括基序 A 环和支持螺旋的变化。总之,这些发现扩展了 RSV 易位后阶段的结构景观并完善了当前的 NAC 模型。更广泛地说,我们的结果强调未反应的状态匹配复合物作为反应衍生结构的补充方法,用于捕获动态反应循环的更完整的结构快照。

title: Tidal-Breathing Analysis: A Potential Non-Invasive, Bedside Method for Objective Assessment of Respiratory Mechanics and Bronchodilator Responsiveness in Acute Bronchiolitis—Case Report and Review of the Literature
abstract: Background: Acute bronchiolitis is among the most common causes of lower-respiratory-tract infection in infancy and remains a clinically heterogeneous syndrome. Current international guidelines recommend supportive management and generally discourage routine bronchodilator administration; however, a subset of patients may be physiologically responsive. Tidal-breathing analysis (TBA) is a non-invasive, bedside method for objectively assessing respiratory mechanics and may objectively quantify physiological changes following bronchodilator administration in older children. Case Presentation: We report the case of a 23-month-old boy presenting with a severe RSV bronchiolitis-like wheezing illness complicated by acute respiratory failure. Bronchodilator responsiveness was evaluated using predefined TBA parameters before and after administration of an inhaled bronchodilator. Following treatment, the patient’s time to peak tidal expiratory flow (tPTEF) increased from 0.17 to 0.33 s (+94%), while his tPTEF/TE ratio increased from 0.12 to 0.27 (+125%). Expiratory time (TE) and total respiratory cycle duration (Ttot) decreased by 12.6% and 5.1%, respectively, whereas tidal volume (VT) and minute ventilation (MV) increased by 12.1% and 18.3%. Peak expiratory flow remained unchanged (0.14 L/s before and after bronchodilator administration). Discussion: To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first reports of using bedside TBA to characterize acute bronchodilator responsiveness in a severe bronchiolitis-like illness. The improvement in expiratory timing indices, along with the shorter expiratory time without changes in peak expiratory flow, is consistent with improved expiratory flow dynamics following bronchodilator administration. These findings could support the hypothesis that a bronchodilator-responsive physiological phenotype may exist. Previous studies have demonstrated an association between severe bronchiolitis during infancy and subsequent recurrent wheezing or asthma; however, whether acute bronchodilator responsiveness, measured objectively via TBA, is an indication of this phenotype represents a testable hypothesis for future longitudinal studies. Conclusions: This case illustrates the feasibility of bedside TBA for identifying physiological bronchodilator responsiveness in severe bronchiolitis-like illness. Prospective longitudinal studies should be conducted to determine whether TBA-defined responsiveness represents an early physiological marker requiring prospective validation and whether such physiological stratification may support individualized follow-up strategies.
